issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1533 (se/1521-stitching-upload-v1, merged into se/1520-stitching-v1).

  • New StitchingUploadV1Controller / StitchingUploadV1Action / StitchingUploadV1Dto, replacing legacy StreetEditor\V1\Actions\StitchingUploadV1::execute(). The legacy StreetEditor\V1 Actions directory is now empty and was removed.
  • Migrated code is not namespaced under StreetEditor\V1 — flat under StreetEditor (route path v1/stitching/upload preserved; only the PHP namespace changed), same convention as stitching-v1.
  • Pure raw passthrough: the Action streams the uploaded file as multipart field image to {BASE_URL_STITCHING_V1}/upload (STITCH_API_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT, default 120s, floored at 120s if configured below 30s) and always returns the upstream status/body/headers unchanged. No domain exceptions, no failure branching in the Action.
  • image validation (required|file + explicit isValid() check) stays in the Controller via Validator::make, not a thrown domain exception — same deliberate deviation as stitching-v1, to preserve the legacy data.input (per-field validator error) response shape.
  • Talks to the same upstream as stitching-v1 (BASE_URL_STITCHING_V1), distinct from stitching/upload-stitching/delete-stitching (BASE_URL_STITCHING).
  • No new domainCode/HTTP exceptions — this endpoint has none (see table below).
domainCode HTTP Condition
(Controller-level validation, no domainCode) 409 image missing/not a file/invalid upload
(fallback \Throwable) 500/503 unexpected error, upstream stitch-api failure

Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1534 (se/1522-generate-thumbnail, merged into se/1521-stitching-upload-v1).

  • New GenerateThumbnailController / GenerateThumbnailAction / GenerateThumbnailDto, replacing legacy StreetEditor\Actions\GenerateThumbnail::execute().
  • (Re)generates a 1500×750 equirectangular thumbnail from a panorama's full image via GD (getimagesize → imagecreatefromjpeg → imagecopyresampled → imagejpeg at quality 85).
  • Reuses four exception classes already bootstrapped for upload-stitching — no new domainCodes introduced: StreetEditorPanoramaNotFoundException (409), StreetEditorPanoramaImageNotFoundException (409), StreetEditorUploadFailedException (500), StreetEditorDeleteFailedException (500).
  • Thumbnail path derivation differs from upload-stitching: always {full_image_dirname}/{full_image_filename}_thumb.jpg, rather than reading the panorama's thumb_local_path column.
  • No ownership check on panoId — this is a self-use/internal endpoint, matches legacy.
  • messages.success_generate_thumbnail has no entry in resources/lang/en/messages.php, resolves to the literal key string — preserved bug-for-bug from legacy.

STREETEDITOR.PANORAMA_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND 409 panorama's full image file missing on disk
STREETEDITOR.UPLOAD_FAILED 500 getimagesize / imagecreatefromjpeg / imagejpeg failure
STREETEDITOR.DELETE_FAILED 500 unlink() failure removing an existing thumbnail

Enhancement architecture

Target: Domain-Based ADR per docs/ARCH_RULES.md.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1612 (enhance/issue-1372-agency-adr-foundation, merged into main) — shared ADR foundation for the Agency domain. No route or response behavior changed; this branch only adds infrastructure consumed by #1610 and #1611.

  • New AgencyDomainException base (extends the global App\Exceptions\DomainException, exposes getDomainCode()), plus AgencyNotFoundException, ModerationNotFoundException, ModerationNotSharableException, and AgencyExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode().
  • Deviation from scope: AgencyTourFetchFailedException was not created — no failure branch in either endpoint reaches it. InvalidAgencyRequestException (AGENCY.INVALID_INPUT → 400) was added instead, because /agency/moderation-data needs an explicit 400 for a missing mid. The mapper therefore emits 400 / 403 / 404 only; unhandled failures fall through to errorResponseFromThrowable() for the 500 case.
  • New AgencyRepository absorbs AgencyClass::getAgencyDetailsBySubAgentID(), AgencyClass::createQueryAgencyTours(), and the inline tableAgency() / tableModeration() queries previously living inside GetModerationData. Exposed as findAgencyDetailsBySubAgent(), countAgencyTours(), getAgencyTours(), hasModerationAccess(), findModerationShareData(), with the shared buildToursQuery() private. Left non-final for the same reason as ToursRepository / LevelRepository (test doubles).
  • ResponseEnvelopeHelper::rawResponse() added here (not in the original scope) so #1611 can return the plain {statusCode, data} envelope without an encrypt step.
  • Follow-up commit dce7357 hardened the foundation against null agency_id and translation-key drift; agency messages now live under messages.agency.* in resources/lang/en/messages.php.

issues.display_title: Issue #1696: Portfolio Logo Is Wiped on Every About Save
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

POST /portfolios (PortfolioController@createPortfolio) always writes logo into the update payload, and $logo falls back to '' whenever the request carries no file:

if (isset($fileName) && strlen($fileName) > 0) {
    $logo = "http://gothru.co/moderation/" . $userId . "/" . $fileName;
} else {
    $logo = '';   // <- wipes the stored logo
}

The dashboard only appends logo when a new file is picked, so saving the About form after changing any other field clears the stored logo. It is silent: the UI keeps showing the old image until the page is reloaded.

The same payload also makes "logo removed" and "logo untouched" indistinguishable — the remove button only appears to work because of this bug.

Expected behavior

  • A save that carries no logo keeps whatever is already stored.
  • Clearing the logo requires an explicit signal from the client.
  • The old file on disk is removed when the logo is replaced or cleared.

Acceptance criteria

  • Saving the About form without re-picking a logo leaves portfolio.logo unchanged.
  • Uploading a new logo replaces the value and unlinks the previous file.
  • remove_logo clears the value and unlinks the previous file.
  • Unlinking a file that is already gone does not raise a warning.

Related

  • Frontend issue: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4135
  • PR: #1695

Dev update — 2026-07-22

PR #1695 (base main), commit e2d96342f, one file: PortfolioController@createPortfolio.

The current logo is read once up front, and $logo now resolves three ways instead of two:

request result
new file new URL, old file unlinked
remove_logo '', old file unlinked
neither unchanged — this is the fix

INSERT path stays safe: no row means $oldLogo is ''. The unlink is now in one place for both paths, behind an is_file guard.

php -l clean. No automated test — the controller builds every collaborator with new in its constructor, so covering it needs a DI refactor bigger than the fix. Manual: (1) change only the phone → save → reload, logo intact; (2) upload new logo, old file gone; (3) remove logo, value and file gone.

Merge before GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4134 — alone this fixes the wipe but the remove button stays inert until the client sends remove_logo.

Still open in this endpoint: mimes:png returns a bare 400 with no field detail; BASE_DIR vs the /data/ unlink path only agree if BASE_DIR is /data/moderation/; success returns data.message while errors return data.messages.
